mapper.sql: SELECT t.buy_id, t.purchase_no, t.user_id, t.user_name, t.user_type, t.dept_name, t.buy_num, t.audit_status, t.audit_user_id, t.audit_time, t.reject_reason, t.audit_opinion, t.receive_time, t.submit_time, t.create_time, t.del_flag, t.funding_source, t.file_hash, t.supplier_id, t.purchase_status, t.archived, t.logistics_no, t.logistics_company, t.invoice_no, t.verify_user_id, t.verify_time, t.verify_result, t.verify_remark, t.quality_check_result, t.actual_qty_received FROM textbook_buy t WHERE t.del_flag = '0'

mapper.update:

audit_status=#{status}, audit_user_id=#{auditUserId}, reject_reason=#{rejectReason}, audit_opinion=#{auditOpinion}, receive_time=NOW(), supplier_id=#{supplierId}, purchase_status=#{purchaseStatus}, logistics_no=#{logisticsNo}, logistics_company=#{logisticsCompany}, invoice_no=#{invoiceNo}, verify_user_id=#{verifyUserId}, verify_time=#{verifyTime}, verify_result=#{verifyResult}, verify_remark=#{verifyRemark}, quality_check_result=#{qualityCheckResult}, actual_qty_received=#{actualQtyReceived}, WHERE buy_id=#{buyId} AND del_flag='0'

UPDATE textbook_buy SET del_flag='1' WHERE buy_id IN #{buyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_purchase_detail(purchase_id, book_id, book_name, isbn, quantity, unit_price, total_price, edition, textbook_type, college, major, grade) VALUES(#{purchaseId}, #{bookId}, #{bookName}, #{isbn}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{edition}, #{textbookType}, #{college}, #{major}, #{grade})

INSERT INTO textbook_purchase_detail(purchase_id, book_id, book_name, isbn, quantity, unit_price, total_price, edition, textbook_type, college, major, grade) VALUES
(#{item.purchaseId}, #{item.bookId}, #{item.bookName}, #{item.isbn}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.totalPrice}, #{item.edition}, #{item.textbookType}, #{item.college}, #{item.major}, #{item.grade})
mapper.select: SELECT pd.detail_id, pd.purchase_id, pd.book_id, pd.book_name, pd.isbn, pd.quantity, pd.unit_price, pd.total_price, pd.edition, pd.textbook_type, pd.college, pd.major, pd.grade, pd.supplier_feedback, pd.supplier_remark, pd.verify_status, pd.received_qty, pd.return_qty, pd.return_reason, pd.info_correction, ti.author, ti.publisher FROM textbook_purchase_detail pd LEFT JOIN textbook_info ti ON pd.book_id = ti.book_id WHERE pd.purchase_id = #{purchaseId}

SELECT pd.detail_id, pd.purchase_id, pd.book_id, pd.book_name, pd.isbn, pd.quantity, pd.unit_price, pd.total_price, pd.edition, pd.textbook_type, pd.college, pd.major, pd.grade, pd.supplier_feedback, pd.supplier_remark, pd.verify_status, pd.received_qty, pd.return_qty, pd.return_reason, pd.info_correction, ti.author, ti.publisher FROM textbook_purchase_detail pd LEFT JOIN textbook_info ti ON pd.book_id = ti.book_id WHERE pd.purchase_id IN #{purchaseId} ORDER BY purchase_id, detail_id

SELECT t.buy_id, t.purchase_no, t.user_id, t.user_name, t.user_type, t.dept_name, t.buy_num, t.audit_status, t.audit_user_id, t.audit_time, t.reject_reason, t.audit_opinion, t.receive_time, t.submit_time, t.create_time, t.del_flag, t.funding_source, t.file_hash, t.supplier_id, t.purchase_status, t.archived, t.logistics_no, t.logistics_company, t.invoice_no FROM textbook_buy t WHERE t.del_flag = '0' AND t.supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND t.purchase_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{purchaseNo},'%') AND t.purchase_status = #{status} ORDER BY t.submit_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM textbook_buy WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND purchase_status IN ('1', '2') AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT pd.detail_id, pd.purchase_id, pd.book_id, pd.book_name, pd.isbn, pd.quantity, pd.unit_price, pd.total_price, pd.edition, pd.textbook_type, pd.college, pd.major, pd.grade, pd.supplier_feedback, pd.supplier_remark, pd.verify_status, pd.received_qty, pd.return_qty, pd.return_reason, pd.info_correction, ti.author, ti.publisher FROM textbook_purchase_detail pd LEFT JOIN textbook_info ti ON pd.book_id = ti.book_id WHERE pd.detail_id = #{detailId}
